title: Sebastian and the Promise
author: Zephyrine Sandoval
blurb: Silas Whitlock, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
